title: A* pathfinding engine module + bot AI strategic integration (replaces direction-scoring with goal-based planning)
intent: User feedback 2026-06-02: 'на сложных картах где много препятствий боты очень тупят'. Current bot AI (post S220-S225 tactical refactor) uses per-cardinal direction scoring — reactive, no multi-cell planning. On the new arena variants (chokepoint S231, cluster-rooms S233) bots oscillate at narrow passages, fail to reach goals around cliffs/ramps, can't plan soft-block mining. Fix: implement A* pathfinding as engine primitive (`engine/grid/pathfinding/`) — performant via binary-heap priority queue + closed-set bitmap. Bot AI replaces direction-scoring with goal-based planning: each tick, evaluate goals (player position, pickups, safe cell) → A* path → take next step. Path cache with invalidation on grid changes (bomb spawn, block destroy). Respects cliffs / ramps / step-jumps / bombs / bomb-pass exceptions / hazards. Target: <2ms for typical 21×21 arena, scales to 50×50 cell maps.
rationale: Source: user playtest feedback 2026-06-02 on complex arenas. Bot AI currently good at tactical reactions (S220-S225) but bad at strategic positioning — A* closes the strategic gap. Engine-first per CLAUDE.md (any AGF grid game with bots benefits — future Beacon World drones, future RPG sample). Pairs naturally with shipped: variable height (S173), ramps (S174), step-jumps (S015 if shipped — verify), bot personality + tactics (S139, S220-S224), bot anticipation (S225). Replaces per-direction-scoring approach that has accumulated 3+ sprint refactors trying to compensate (S236-S237 bot-ai refactors).
acceptanceHints: DIRECTORY: NEW `engine/grid/pathfinding/`. Generic — used by any grid game.
CORE API (engine/grid/pathfinding/astar.ts):
pathfind(world, options): PathfindResult
options = { start: {gx, gz}, goal: {gx, gz} | GoalPredicate, maxNodes?: number, edgeWeight?: (from, to) => number, blockedPredicate?: (cell) => boolean }
Returns: { path: Cell[], cost: number, exhausted: boolean }
Pure function — no ECS dependency in the core. World queries (occupancy, height, hazards) come via injected getters from the bot caller.
ALGORITHM:
Standard A* with:
- Open list: binary heap (priority queue) ordered by f = g + h.
- Closed list: bitmap indexed by gx*gridHeight + gz. O(1) lookups.
- Heuristic: Manhattan distance (4-cardinal movement). Admissible.
- Reconstruct path via parent-pointer chain on goal hit.
- maxNodes cap (default 500) prevents runaway on impossible goals.
EDGE-WEIGHT RULES (the project's responsibility, but engine ships sensible defaults):
edgeWeight(from, to) controls cost per neighbour traversal:
Flat → 1.0 (default move).
Cliff (height delta > 1, no ramp) → ∞ (impassable).
Ramp (height delta == 1) → 1.2 (slight cost — discourages pure-ramp pathing when flat available).
Step-jump (height delta == 1, no ramp) → 1.5 (more expensive than ramp — jumping is harder).
Soft block → 10.0 (high cost — bot must consider whether mining is worth it).
Bomb cell → ∞ (impassable) UNLESS bot has canBombPass AND bomb owned by self → 1.0.
Conveyor cell → 0.8 (slight discount — conveyors aid movement when aligned).
Warp cell → 0.3 (very cheap — teleport).
Danger map score > 0.7 → 5.0 (avoid danger but not impossible).
PERFORMANCE TARGETS:
21×21 typical arena (441 cells): <2ms per query on modern laptop.
50×50 stretch arena (2500 cells): <10ms per query.
Bot tick rate: pathfind once per ~200ms (5 Hz) per bot. At 4 bots × 5 queries/sec = 20 queries/sec = 40ms/sec overhead. Acceptable.
Binary heap implementation — typed-array backed, ~32 bytes per node. ~10KB heap for 500-node search.
PATH CACHING + INVALIDATION:
Cache key: (botEntityId, goal). Cached PathfindResult.
Reuse cache when bot's next-tick goal matches AND the world hasn't invalidated.
Invalidation triggers (event-driven, NOT poll):
Bomb spawned at cell → invalidate paths crossing or near that cell.
Soft block destroyed at cell → invalidate paths blocked by it.
Conveyor / Warp state changed → invalidate paths using it.
Bot's own position drifted >2 cells from path's first cell → invalidate (path stale).
Invalidation simple v1: clear ALL caches on any grid event. Cheaper than per-cell invalidation; sub-1ms cost.
BOT AI INTEGRATION (examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bot-ai-system.ts):
Bot's decision tree REPLACES per-cardinal direction scoring with:
1. Identify candidate goals: nearest_player, nearest_pickup, safe_cell (lowest danger), nearest_soft_block (for Miner / mining scenarios).
2. Per personality bias: Hunter weights player goal high, Coward weights safe_cell high, Miner weights soft_block high.
3. For each candidate goal: run pathfind(bot.cell, goal). Score = goal_priority / path.cost.
4. Pick highest-scoring goal + take FIRST STEP of returned path.
5. Cache the path for next tick — only re-pathfind on goal change or invalidation.
Bomb placement decisions: separate from pathfinding (existing tactical-power-up logic from S220-S224 stays).
SOFT-BLOCK MINING STRATEGY (NEW capability via pathfinding):
When pathfind returns a high-cost path traversing soft blocks (because no flat route exists): bot interprets this as 'mine the wall':
Identify the first soft-block cell in the path.
Move to an adjacent cell of that soft block.
Place a bomb (existing bomb-placement logic).
Wait for blast (existing flee logic via danger map).
Re-pathfind after blast (cache invalidation triggers).
Continue toward original goal.
This is the Miner personality's main loop. Other personalities use it incidentally when boxed in.
TESTS:
pathfind(start=(0,0), goal=(5,5), flat arena) → path of length 10 (Manhattan).
pathfind blocked by hard-block wall → finds detour OR returns no-path.
pathfind across cliff WITH ramp → uses ramp (path goes via ramp cell, cost 1.2× normal).
pathfind across cliff WITHOUT ramp → finds detour OR no-path (no step-jump in v1 — leave for GDP-2026-05-28-015 if it ships).
pathfind with bomb on path → routes around. With canBombPass + own bomb → routes through.
Performance: 21×21 arena pathfind <2ms median across 100 random start-goal pairs.
Invalidation: cache hit on unchanged grid + cache miss after bomb spawn event.
Bot integration: Coward bot on chokepoint arena finds high-ground escape route via ramp.
Bot integration: Miner bot in cluster-room arena pathfinds through soft-block mining sequence.
MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative gameplay from S125):
Server-side bot AI runs pathfinding identical to client. Same world state → same paths.
No protocol changes — bot decisions output via existing PlaceBombRequest + inputIntent path.
DOCTOR INTEGRATION:
engine doctor section: 'Pathfinding cache: N entries, M hits/sec, P invalidations/sec'. Warning if invalidations dominate hits (cache thrashing).
URL CONFIG:
`?botPathfinding=off` reverts to old direction-scoring. Useful for A/B testing + screenshot regressions.
`?botPathfindMaxNodes=N` overrides 500-node cap.
OUT OF SCOPE (FUTURE STORIES if needed):
Jump Point Search (JPS) optimization — A* is fine for our arena sizes; JPS pays off at 100×100+.
Hierarchical pathfinding (HPA*) — overkill until arenas exceed ~50×50.
Theta* / Any-angle pathfinding — 4-cardinal only.
Player-controlled hero with pathfinding (mouse-click-to-move). Bot-only in v1.
Multi-bot coordinated pathfinding (squad behaviour). Independent paths per bot.
Adaptive heuristic weighting (W*A*). Manhattan is good enough.
Pathfinding-aware bomb-placement (place bomb to MAXIMISE opponent's path cost). Out — separate strategic layer.
Replay determinism — pathfinding is deterministic per (grid state, edge weights, start, goal). Bot decisions reproducible.
